title: Steering fleet
current: Undelivered receipts in an actively draining machine wake queue show their positions in wake claim order. description: Watcher updates mark a heading (changes only) when any descendant row is omitted. Whole sections keep their headings; no longer listed is the only removal signal. Seen rows use unsuffixed headings.
